    The independent translate is the translation of Γ_A #

    The independent statement defines τ X_i = X_t by an almost split sequence 0 → X_t → E → X_i → 0 of right modules, with the almost split properties tested on finite-dimensional modules. The proof library takes the translation from the vendored Auslander–Reiten theory: the kernel of the chosen minimal right almost split map in the category mod A = FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ of finitely generated right modules. This file proves that the two agree (translateCompatible).

    • The inclusion mod A → Mod A is fully faithful and exact, so split monomorphisms and epimorphisms, almost split maps and short exact sequences correspond.
    • The vendored sequence is an almost split sequence.
    • Conversely, in an almost split sequence the first map is radical, so the second map is right minimal; uniqueness of minimal right almost split maps identifies the left term with the vendored translate.
